notes.title: AI, Bug Fixes, better visuals!
notes.content:
Hi all,

This update includes a small hive based AI for the enemies, which makes them feel more like actual ships and not just objects that follow your hand around!

In addition, as many of you know Unreal Engine 4.14 came out which enables the Forward Renderer for VR. This allowed us to super-sample a little and use better Anti-Aliasing, so everything should be much clearer now!

Finally, some minor tweaks were made that should help both CPU and GPU performance, along with a few bug fixes. The most notable of which is that the third map was unusable in the last update, but it is fixed now, and exiting via steam's overlay is a little bit faster and correct now. 

Some of the smaller bug fixes are listed below:
Fixed menu pointer not showing up
Fixed drone vibration in hand when moving not working
Fixed some menu buttons being hard to press
Fixed random music stopping
Fixed a crash that would happen when too many enemies were on screen

Thanks!

notes.title: Update! Halloween over! Performance improvements again! Brand new music!
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

We have a pretty small update for everyone today that mainly removed the Halloween theme since it's November now, but I also included a few other quick things. There's about a 10% performance increase across the board and new music that we hope you all will love! Finally, we fixed the antivirus issue, and no longer will there be any false positives!

Thanks!

notes.title: Bug fixes and a few extra things in prep for a large update!
notes.content:
Waves 31-40 have now been added
A few new enemies and bosses!
Rockets explosions are now smaller
Increased the resolution of the textures, making everything less blurry!
Replaced the dark theme with a brighter white sci-fi lab theme
The controller/control info now disapears on game start
Fixed bugs affecting bosses 15 and 20 making them shoot incorrectly
Fixed bugs affecting the core game mode
Fixed a bug that would cause powerup flashing to loop
Fixed a bug that caused the autotower to spawn abnormally huge
Fixed the center being un-aligned with the environment
Enemies now all get destroyed when you die to stop any extra point gains
Rockets are now way slower and more accurate + they do more damage!
Changed the "shotgun enemy" to be more like a passive bullet spawner
Fixed many more bugs not listed here, notably including score glitches
Made "Easy" a bit easier as some people still found it too hard!

We have more waves, powerups, and enemies in the works, but decided to release a smaller patch to fix bugs and make some general improvements with a few new waves in preparation for the larger content update!

P.S. Leaderboard has been reset, as we fixed some bugs involving a score exploit.
